correctness.rationale: For X=Bl_L(P3_C), the fixed-source Cox parameter space of degree class (4,2) is 17-dimensional. With fixed basepoint-free v2,v3 and w, the 2-plane W=w·span(v2,v3) in H0(O(4)) converts planarity to rank([u0],[u1])≤1 for a 3×2 matrix: irreducible codimension 2. Every such containing plane meets L transversely, so its proper transform S=Bl_p(P2) has O(8)=N_{f/S}, and the normal sequence 0→O(8)→N_{f/X}→O(4)→0 splits because H1(O(4))=0. The explicit Cox witness has immersion minors 4sA5 and -4t²B4 with gcd 1 and resultant 1984; independent symbolic reconstruction reproduced these polynomials, their gcd, and the source Appendix-A 16×16 cohomology matrix rank 14. This confirms depth h1(N(-7))=2 throughout the planar locus, versus generic splitting O(6)²/rank16. No claim is made that the entire second jump locus is pure or classified.
